root_idea.summary: The lexical orientation is firmness, fixing, and decisive determination, though the root analysis is explicitly uncertain and is tentatively connected with the semantic field of ح ك م.
root_idea.development: From making an affair firm or settled, the evidence develops meanings of decree, judicial determination, necessity, and inevitability; related lexical branches also describe breaking apart and what remains as crumbs.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Classical Arabic noun citation form حَتْمٌ rather than the Quranic accusative surface form حَتْمًا.

senses.definition: A predetermined decree or judicially settled determination; in the Quranic use, an irrevocably fixed decree.
senses.usage_conditions: In حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا, the accusative noun denotes a decree decisively determined by God, with the contextual force of inevitability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make firm, establish, or settle a thing or affair firmly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I transitive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decree, ordain, pronounce, or decide a matter judicially.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used with بِهِ or عَلَيْهِ in constructions of deciding or decreeing a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something necessary, requisite, or unavoidable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With عَلَيْهِ, to make a thing or event necessary for someone to do or suffer; also used with بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing necessary or unavoidable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wish someone good or augur good for him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the construction تَحَتَّمَ لِفُلَانٍ بِخَيْرٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Softness, yieldingness, crumbliness, or a tendency to break easily; of food, freshness, juiciness, or moistness in that soft condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use describing the soft or crumbly quality of an edible thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To crumble or break into small pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of something that breaks apart or falls into pieces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat a soft or crumbly thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive usage describing the eating of food soft enough to break apart in the mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food remaining on a table or fallen from it during eating, such as bread crumbs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to remnants or crumbs of food left after eating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cheerful, brisk, lively, or sprightly because of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the thing that occasions the change in state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become absolutely, decisively, or irreversibly necessary, requisite, or unavoidable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing, affair, or event that becomes settled as unavoidable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut or cut off a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately attested quadriliteral lexical formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A legal term used for qaḍāʾ, as opposed to adāʾ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical legal terminology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Necessary, requisite, or unavoidable; indissoluble or irreversible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or epithetic use, including in descriptions of a decree, ordinance, sentence, or judicial decision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pure, free from admixture, genuine, or true.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally, including of a genuine or true brother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blackness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal color term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flask broken into small pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a vessel reduced to fragments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Acidity, sourness, or pungency.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A taste or sensory quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A judge, or one who decrees, ordains, or pronounces a judicial decision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun associated with deciding or issuing a decree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A crow, including the crow associated with separation or ill omen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is connected with the belief that the bird’s croaking portends separation or departure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unlucky or inauspicious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred adjectival use associated with the omen-bearing crow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A green earthenware jar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a jar of the specified traditional color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something black.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is also applied to an object described by the color term أَسْوَد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Black.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applying to anything black.
